verdict.rationale: Oneleet's own docs confirm a hosted, customizable Trust Center that you set up, publish, and link from your landing page. That covers the core of a public trust center. The evidence is the same single guide passage repeated, and it says nothing about what the Trust Center actually shows or how it gates access. Missing for 10: live/continuous control status display, certifications shown on the trust center, NDA click-through gated report sharing, any evidence it shortens security reviews, independent or hands-on corroboration.
